t: Re-run 5 priority AI queries; log citation deltas
note: The habit that proves GEO is working. Compare to last week; flag any drops.
exec: Run the 5 priority queries across the 4 engines.
Record cited vs competitor; note the change vs last week.
Flag any page that lost a citation.
Log it in the tracking sheet.

t: Check Search Console for new errors + movers
note: Catch coverage drops and ranking shifts early.
exec: Pull last-7-day GSC: new errors, coverage drops.
Identify top gaining + losing pages/queries.
Summarize what changed + one action to take.

note: Make sure every lead is tracked to its source.
exec: Pull this week's leads; confirm each has source/campaign.
Flag any with broken/missing attribution.
Report best + worst performing ad page this week.

note: Response speed is a local ranking + trust signal.
exec: Check Google + Birdeye for new reviews.
Draft replies for my approval (I post).
Flag any negative review needing a call.

note: 5–10 new referring domains/mo doesn't happen by accident. One fixed weekly block.
exec: Send 5 new pitches (certs, suppliers, chamber, sponsorships, journalists).
Follow up on 5 open threads.
Log any won links with target page + anchor.

t: Publish or refresh one content piece
note: Refreshes help only when they add real value: updated facts, clearer answers, local proof, photos, reviews, or better internal links.
exec: Publish or refresh one page/post with GEO formatting.
Direct-answer intro, fact density, updated date.
Build in Draft for approval.

t: Full site crawl for 404s, orphans, broken redirects
note: Catch link rot before it accumulates.
exec: Crawl the full site for 404s, orphan pages, broken redirects, missing titles/meta.
Deliver a prioritized fix list.
Fix the critical ones in Draft for approval.

t: Refresh top 5 pages when there is a real update
note: Keep your best pages accurate and useful; update dateModified only when the content meaningfully changes.
exec: Identify top 5 pages by traffic and conversion importance.
Refresh facts/copy/photos/internal links where there is a real improvement; update dateModified only when justified.
Report what changed and why it helps users.

note: Measure citation share vs last month — the scoreboard.
exec: Re-run the full 30-query baseline across 4 engines.
Compare citation share to last month.
Show the delta + where you gained/lost ground.
Re-pull competitor movement + new keyword gaps.
Flag new opportunities + threats.
Feed winners into next cycle's plan.

note: Target 8–12 new Google reviews/mo per market. Below pace two months running = fix the ask process.
exec: Pull new-review count + avg rating per location.
Compare to target; flag markets below pace.
Adjust ask timing/channel where behind.

t: 30/60/90 gate check — jobs won, not rankings
note: Score against the Revenue Scorecard checkpoints. A Day-90 Boise miss = authority gap confirmed → shift budget from content to links.
exec: Score every checkpoint pass/fail for the current gate.
Pull CallRail/GA4 organic-attributed Boise leads.
Count new referring domains vs 682 baseline.
Decide: stay course, or reallocate content budget to links.

note: Keep, kill, or iterate each LP on the numbers.
exec: Review each LP: LCP, conversion rate, cost per lead.
Recommend keep / kill / iterate.
Draft the next test.
Confirm the backup ran this month.
Confirm a restore is possible.
Report status.
